{{Top|leg}}
'''Holorecording macrobinoculars''' were a type of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] with the capability to record images [[holograph]]ically within a fifty [[Meter/Legends|meter]] line of sight. The [[Mark IV sentry droid/Legends|Mark IV sentry droid]] was equipped with holorecording macrobinoculars.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
